First Installment - Erection, testing and commissioning

special_requirements: Extension of Defect Liability Period in aggregate shall not exceed 24 months
Contractor's liability for latent defects warranty shall be limited to 5 years from end of Defect Liability Period
Performance Security shall be valid till 180 days beyond Defect Liability Period
Electrical Inspector inspection required after successful completion with necessary fee paid by Employer
Defects/incomplete works notified by Electrical Inspectorate shall be completed by contractor at no extra cost
If materials found rusted during execution, contractor must remove inferior painting, clean surface and re-paint as per specifications
Third Party Quality Monitoring Agency (TPQMA) penalty provision for defects found in field inspection
Critical defects: 1% penalty on sanctioned cost
Major defects: 0.5% penalty on sanctioned cost
Minor defects: 0% penalty if rectified within 30 days

eligibility_and_qualification.bidding_capacity: Equal to or more than estimated cost of tender, calculated as: [A X N X 2] - B, where A = Maximum annual turnover in last 5 FYs, N = 3 years, B = Value of existing commitments

financial.requirement: The Net Worth of the bidder must be positive for each of the last three Financial Years. Net worth means the sum total of the paid-up capital and free reserves (excluding reserves created out of revaluation) reduced by aggregate value of accumulated losses and intangible assets.
MAAT of the Bidder for best three years out of last five financial years should not be less than 30% of estimated tender cost.

Bidder must have liquid assets and/or evidence of access to or availability of fund based credit facilities of not less than 10% of estimated tender cost. The Credit facility must be earmarked for the Works specified under Bid on receipt of the Bid.

In case of JV bid: All partners shall meet individually para 2.2.1 (Net Worth) and collectively para 2.2.2 & 2.2.3. At least one partner shall meet not less than 40% of minimum criteria for MAAT and liquid assets. Each other partner shall meet not less than 25% of the criteria.
All pending litigations shall in total not be more than fifty percent (50%) of the bidder's net worth. If amount is more than 50% of bidder's net worth, bidder shall be disqualified.
Work experiences shall be considered only if executed under Govt./Semi-Govt./autonomous body of Central/State Govt./Electricity Power Utility/Power Deptt. in India only.

Bidder should possess necessary license for execution of works. If bidder does not hold license for given State, should possess equivalent license for any one State in India and acquire necessary license for given State within two months post-award.
Subcontractors' technical experience and financial resources shall not be taken into account in determining Bidder's compliance with qualifying criteria.

technical.heading_note: For the purpose of this particular bid, bidder shall meet the following minimum criteria in past 7 years up to 31/03/2026

options.requirement: Experience in similar work under single contract, costing not less than 70% of the tender cost excluding GST. The costing should be of completed works only under the contract.
Experience in similar works under two contracts, each costing not less than 40% of the tender cost excluding GST. The costing should be of completed works only under the contract.
Experience in similar works under three contracts, each costing not less than 30% of the tender cost excluding GST. The costing should be of completed works only under the contract.

technical.similar_works_definition: Experience in similar work should be of the nature of one or more of the following: 1) EHT lines 2) HT lines 3) LT lines 4) Distribution transformers 5) Substations. However, experience in only LT lines would not be considered eligible.

scope_of_work.details: Site survey, network design, field survey for deciding location of poles, distribution transformers, proposed route of 33 KV, 11KV and LT lines, proposed location of 33/11 KV sub-stations with number, capacity of power transformers and number of 11 KV feeders to be taken out, locations of new distribution transformers

Providing engineering data and drawings for review, approval and records, preparation of feeder wise Bill of Quantity (BOQ) for each proposed work, architectural and civil designs approval, development of detailed project implementation schedule

Supply, manufacturer's quality assurance, testing (where specified/required), transportation, storage of all equipment and materials including power transformers, distribution transformers, HT & LT lines with overhead conductor, poles, insulators, stay wire, underground distribution system with feeder pillars, UG cables, automation devices like RMUs, FPI, auto-reclosures

Erection, fabrication, pre-assembly (if any), including all civil/structural works, installation of all equipment/materials, all construction works at power sub-stations, 66 kV lines, 33 kV lines, 11 kV lines, DTR substations, LT lines, HVDS, augmentation/renovation of systems

Site testing, commissioning of all items & materials, pre-commissioning tests, commissioning tests, putting into satisfactory operation of all equipment/materials including successful commissioning, factory and site testing

Design, engineering, and construction of all civil works at power sub-station, 66 kV line, 33 kV line, 11 kV line, DTR substation, LT line, HVDS, foundations for equipment, transformers, isolators, VCB, control rooms, all architectural and civil designs, soil investigation

Project management system implementation, quality assurance and evaluation mechanism, compliance monitoring, progress reporting, physical and financial progress uploading in web portal, supervision and engineering services

GIS mapping & asset tagging of all new assets created under System Strengthening, updating GIS coordinates and associated mapping information of new assets created/upgraded using mobile app provided by employer, collection of attributes data model for each asset

Preparation of project completion report/closure proposal, preparation of as-built drawings, operations and maintenance manuals, training, handing over works to employer for taking into commercial services, return of replaced old materials to area stores

New 33 KV Lines, New 33/11 kV Power Substations, New 11 KV Lines, Distribution Transformer Substations, New LT Lines, High voltage distribution system (HVDS), LT AB Cable Reconductoring Work, augmentation and renovation works

Engraving of 'Developed under MPDEP (ADB) Scheme' on materials (poles, transformers, cables, energy meters), installation of signboards for major infrastructures indicating work details, commissioning date, estimated cost, scheme details, colour coding of DTs, compliance with Indian Laws, Standards and Codes

Supply of all raw materials including steel, zinc for galvanizing, reinforcement steel and cement for foundation, coke for earthing, bolts, nuts & washers, danger plates, phase plates, number plates, commissioning spares, recommended spares for 3 years operation
